description: Separate disk volume/filesystem concerns from Ingestion by introducing a Storage role, routing DiskBridge and materialization to Storage, keeping Ingestion focused on indexing/vectorizing/retrieval, and adding OS-backed paginated directory listing.

comments.text: Revised implementation direction: Storage must behave as a normal data-source provider. No Storage-specific columns on documents. Storage owns stable entry UUIDs and live file metadata. DiskBridge emits canonical data-source records with provider disk/config/record-id and Storage materialization handles. Ingestion consumes disk records through existing materialization, permission import, watch, change, and enrichment flows like every other provider.

title: [storage-disk-separation] Move disk volumes to Storage role
